stem.text: The graph shows the vertical velocity of a parachutist during the first $20\,\text{s}$ of her jump.

stem.alt: Velocity against time graph: velocity rises from 0 at t = 0 to about 60 m/s at about 10 s, stays near 60 m/s until about 13 s, then falls to about 8 m/s at 20 s

stem.text: Approximately how far does she fall **before** opening the parachute?
